name: wmkf_ai_prompt-catalog-fields
_comment: Owner decision 2026-11-02 (Justin with Connor): six optional catalog columns for organizing the shared prompt library in Admin. They are descriptive only: no app reads them to run a prompt, and the technical key stays wmkf_ai_promptname. Logical names follow docs/plans/SHARED_PROMPT_LIBRARY_SCOPE_CHANGE_2026-11-02.md and the PR553 plan. All are nullable; additive only.

attributes.description: Human-readable prompt title. The technical prompt name is unchanged.
Workflow group used to organize the prompt library, e.g. reviewer-workflow.
Apps or Power Automate flows that rely on this prompt. Declared by staff, not detected automatically.
Display classification of the prompt, such as application, reference or unclassified. Not an execution permission.
